items.source: Create a new SimpleErrors holder for the given target, using the simple name of the target class as the object name.
items.translation: 为给定的目标创建一个新的SimpleErrorsHolder，使用目标类的简单名称作为对象名称。

items.source: Create a new SimpleErrors holder for the given target.
items.translation: 为给定的目标创建一个新的SimpleErrorsholder。

items.source: target - the target to wrap
items.translation: target - 要包装的目标

items.source: Note that this Errors implementation comes without support for nested paths. It is exclusively designed for the validation of individual top-level objects, not aggregating errors from multiple sources. If this is insufficient for your purposes, use a binding-capable Errors implementation such as BeanPropertyBindingResult.
items.translation: 请注意，此Errors实现不支持嵌套路径。它专为验证单个顶级对象而设计，而非聚合来自多个来源的错误。如果这无法满足您的需求，请使用具有绑定功能的Errors实现，例如BeanPropertyBindingResult。

items.source: Get all errors associated with a field.
items.translation: 获取与字段关联的所有错误。

items.source: Get all global errors.
items.translation: 获取所有全局错误。

items.source: Return the name of the bound root object.
items.translation: 返回绑定根对象的名称。

items.source:
Register a global error for the entire target object,
using the given error description.
items.translation: 使用给定的错误描述，为整个目标对象注册一个全局错误。

items.source:
Return a summary of the recorded errors,
for example, for inclusion in an exception message.
items.translation: 返回已记录错误的摘要，例如用于包含在异常消息中。

items.source: errorArgs - error arguments, for argument binding via MessageFormat (can be null)
items.translation: errorArgs - 错误参数，用于通过 MessageFormat 进行参数绑定（可为 null）

items.source: objectName - the name of the target object for error reporting
items.translation: objectName - 用于错误报告的目标对象名称

items.source: errorCode - error code, interpretable as a message key
items.translation: errorCode - 错误代码，可解释为消息键

items.source: defaultMessage - fallback default message
items.translation: defaultMessage - 回退默认消息

items.source: field - the field name
items.translation: field - 字段名称

items.source: This is a convenience method to avoid repeated reject(..) calls for merging an Errors instance into another Errors instance.
items.translation: 这是一个便捷方法，用于避免在将一个 `Errors` 实例合并到另一个 `Errors` 实例时重复调用 `reject(..)`。

items.source: The default implementation throws UnsupportedOperationException since not all Errors implementations support #addAllErrors.
items.translation: 默认实现会抛出UnsupportedOperationException，因为并非所有Errors实现都支持#addAllErrors。

items.source: Note that the passed-in Errors instance is supposed to refer to the same target object, or at least contain compatible errors that apply to the target object of this Errors instance.
items.translation: 注意，传入的 `<code>Errors` 实例应指向同一个目标对象，或者至少包含适用于此 `<code>Errors` 实例的目标对象的兼容错误。

items.source: The field name may be null or empty String to indicate the current object itself rather than a field of it. This may result in a corresponding field error within the nested object graph or a global error if the current object is the top object.
items.translation: 字段名可以为 `null` 或空字符串，以表示当前对象本身而非其某个字段。这可能导致嵌套对象图中出现相应的字段错误，或者如果当前对象是顶层对象，则会出现全局错误。

items.source: Implementations should be able to determine the type even when the field value is null, for example from some associated descriptor.
items.translation: 实现应能够确定类型，即使字段值为 `null`，例如从某些关联的描述符中。

items.source:
Allows for convenient access to user-specified field values,
even if there were type mismatches.
items.translation: 允许方便地访问用户指定的字段值，即使存在类型不匹配的情况。
